name: core-web
// targets: to see all targets run: nx show project core-web --web

build.//: Not cached. `output: standalone` copies the runtime dependency tree into .next/standalone/node_modules, and under pnpm that tree is symlinks — about thirty of them. Restoring them needs a privilege Windows does not grant an ordinary account, so a cache hit fails the build outright with "A required privilege is not held by the client" on a machine where the build itself works. Caching it and dropping the symlinks from the outputs would be worse: the restore would then succeed and leave an image-shaped directory that cannot start.

docker:build.//: Declared rather than inferred, for the reason written out in core-api: the build context is the workspace root. The browser origin is inlined at build time, so it is a build argument with a local default rather than something read at runtime.
